name: routeros-skills
description: Lint tooling for the routeros-* skills repo (cspell + markdownlint-cli2 + skill validator). The skills themselves are plain Markdown — this package only exists to gate quality in CI and locally.

scripts.check: bun run lint:markdown && bun run lint:cspell && bun run lint:skills && bun run lint:refs
scripts.lint:refs: bun scripts/check-refs.ts && bun scripts/build-refs.ts --check && bun scripts/check-refs.ts --self-test
